1.explanation:
• DataTable/DataTable.mdx: Primary documentation for DataTable including batch actions usage and layout guidelines.
• DataTable/migrate-to-7.x.md: Notes on recent changes in DataTable and batch-actions implementation in v7.
• DataTable/stories/dynamic-content/index.js: Live example that wires up TableBatchActions and TableBatchAction components, used to reproduce the clipping and scroll behaviour.
• Toolbar/Toolbar.mdx: Underlying Toolbar component used by TableBatchActions; contains the CSS and markup patterns for horizontal overflow.
• OverflowMenu/OverflowMenu.mdx: Documents the overflow pattern that TableBatchActions falls back to on narrow viewports (if configured) and helps understand responsive behaviour.
• ButtonSet/ButtonSet.mdx: The grouping component used inside batch actions; relevant to how the buttons are rendered and clipped within the scroll container.
1.bug_scenario: The screenshot shows the DataTable’s batch action toolbar pinned at the top in a narrow viewport (e.g. mobile/Safari). The toolbar contains action buttons (“Download to,” “Move,” “Copy,” “Favorite,” “Send via packages,” “Delete”) and a horizontal scrollbar at the right edge. On small screens the container clips off the first few buttons on the left and the scroll mechanism (overflow-x) does not function properly in Safari—making “Download to” and “Move” inaccessible.
